instruction: Navigate to the legal documents section on the Department of Justice website.

metadata.explanation: This task variation asks the agent to navigate to the legal resources/documents section on justice.gov. The evaluator checks if the URL contains the pattern 'justice.gov/legal-resources' using the existing is_expected_url_pattern_match function. The task maintains similar structure and difficulty as the original task, changing from browsing forms to browsing legal resources.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active URL from Chrome accessibility tree
Metric correctly performs regex pattern matching on the URL
Pattern "justice\.gov/legal-resources" semantically matches the instruction requirement to navigate to legal documents section
Complete coverage: instruction requires navigating to legal documents section, evaluator checks URL contains legal-resources path
Data flow is correct: URL extraction → pattern matching → verification
No postconfig needed - URL state is readily accessible from active tab
Edge cases handled: pattern flexible enough to match various URL structures, handles missing Chrome gracefully
